blocks.text: For online sellers, getting an order is only the beginning. From calculating LBC shipping fees to choosing the right box and preparing waybills, fulfillment can add several manual steps before a parcel is ready for delivery. LBC Express is simplifying this process through its integration with Menue, an e-commerce platform for businesses in the Philippines. LBC shipping is now built into Menue online stores, allowing sellers to book shipments, choose the right box size, view shipping fees, and generate waybills as orders come in.
